text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired - service=inference-gateway - symptom=5xx-rate 4.9% (5m) - region=us-east1 - pd_incident=PD-90022
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty PD-90022 created and notified on-call rotation
alex: i'm jumping on PD-90022, pulling traces now
julia: seeing a quick spike of 502/504s across proxy-pool-b, looks correlated with long-lived connections
kelsey: any recent deploys or config changes?
alex: small proxy config tweak to connection_reuse earlier (~30m ago) to test perf, rolled to 10%
priya: CS reports 3 enterprise customers saw increased 5xx on /v1/embeddings; flagging customer-impact
julia: tailing logs, a lot of "upstream timed out (504)" and keepalive resets, connection error counts rising
kelsey: ok, pausing rollout and shifting canary traffic back -> stable via deploy-control now
alex: verified pause, initiating sequenced restarts of proxy-pool-b per AZ (to avoid flapping)
julia: quick counts:
```
# recent 5xx counts
kubectl -n infra logs proxy-pool-b-0 -c proxy | grep "5.." | tail -n 50
# seeing repeated 504 / 502 patterns
```
kelsey: paging Level2 for visibility (escalation sent)
priya: CS notified customers and posted incident page with ETA ~20m
alex: temporarily bumped keepalive timeout lower on affected hosts, seems to reduce the 504 tail on host-1
julia: hypothesis: connection_reuse + larger payloads -> stale connections to model-pool causing stalls
kelsey: started targeted restart on host-1..3, one AZ at a time
alex: after first AZ restart, 5xx rate dropped to ~1.1% (5m)
priya: ticketing note: affected routes /v1/embeddings, start=1805556666, drivers=proxy connection stalls, mitigation=rollback + restarts
julia: enabling fallback-route for heavy-embeddings customers to eu-west1 temporarily
kelsey: monitoring: 5xx rate steady ~0.5% (5m) after restarts + pause, still watching for 10m
alex: creating follow-up PR to add connection healthchecks + exponential backoff for proxy upstreams :memo:
priya: CS will follow up customers once we confirm 30m stability
julia: keeping PD acknowledged and open, will close when stable for 15m
incident-bot: PD-90022: service stable for 18m, auto-close scheduled if no regression
alex: marking incident as resolved in rotation, will draft a short RCA with deploy hardening actions
pagerduty-bot: PD-90022 closed by automated workflow
priya: thanks all, good coordination. moving post-incident items to #postmortems
kelsey: adding observability alert for upstream connection stalls and a runbook note for quick rollback
julia: :thumbsup: nice work everyone
